title: castanopsis longicaudata
intro: Castanopsis longicaudata, commonly known as Chinese chinquapin, is a plant species in the family Fagaceae. It is a deciduous tree native to China, valued for its medicinal properties and traditional uses. The plant is known for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities, making it effective in treating various ailments such as fever, cough, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of Castanopsis longicaudata include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antibacterial properties.
